function.arguments: {"answer": "The email campaign reduced conversion rates compared to paid search, with an adjusted difference of -0.1307 (email minus paid_search), after accounting for differences in customer segment.", "value": -0.1307, "method": "The raw difference in conversion rates was confounded by customer_segment, as the email campaign was targeted at loyal customers who have higher baseline conversion.
